mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.2pp monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5% from prior month indicate housing sector contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline >0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate margins and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 0.3 percentage points above prior month signals accelerating inflation, prompting delayed monetary easing and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL increases >0.3pp monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth above the 12-month moving average indicates strong labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth exceeding 2.0% annualized signals robust consumer demand, elevating corporate profit expectations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5% from prior month indicate broad supply-side weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both decline > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST decline >0.5% monthly.
